title: The Zwicky Transient Facility Bright Transient Survey I: Spectroscopic Classification and the Redshift Completeness of Local Galaxy Catalogs (Fremling et al.)

episodes.description: Alert to spectroscopic follow-up and preliminary TNS classification for one BTS candidate

chain.op: ingest ZTF MSIP alert packet from Kafka stream
filter cut |b|<=7 deg
filter cut rbscore<0.2
filter cut known star (Tachibana & Miller catalog)
filter cut near very bright stars
filter cut >=2 detections 30 min apart
filter cut negative flux
filter cut at least one epoch m<19
human scanning of light curves, cutouts, catalog cross-matches on GROWTH Marshal
assign spectroscopic follow-up with priority P3/P2/P1 by expected peak
SEDM queue observation (trigger active 7 d)
re-assign to SEDM or larger telescope if unobserved/too faint/ambiguous
reduce spectrum (pysedm / other pipelines)
SNID template matching plus visual inspection
annotate preliminary classification on GROWTH Marshal
report classification to TNS within 1-2 days

episodes.description: Homogeneous re-classification of one BTS SN for the catalog (Table 1)

chain.op: take latest spectrum on Marshal
SNID top 15 matches rlap>=5
plot observed vs redshift-corrected template
visual inspection by one of six team members
record type, redshift, template name and phase
resolve ambiguity by features / light curve / alternative spectra
second team member examines ambiguous cases
final check of ambiguous classifications by two members
assign sub-type under conservative rules

episodes.description: Host galaxy identification, redshift adoption and host photometry for one SN (Table 3)

chain.op: query NED for galaxies within 20 arcsec
assign nearest galaxy with catalogued redshift
fallback nearest galaxy if no redshift
if |zSN-zhost|>0.05 assign nearest galaxy
compute projected separation with zSN
visual inspection of dp>=19 kpc candidates
visual check on PS1 i-band stacks
exclude ambiguous hosts
cross-match host positions to PS1 (Gaia frame)
Tractor forced WISE W1 photometry

episodes.description: Redshift Completeness Factor estimate from SN Ia hosts

chain.op: select SNe Ia with identified hosts
label hit/miss by catalogued redshift
raw RCF 227/512
restricted RCF z<=0.03
convert W1 to absolute magnitude
logistic Bernoulli model fitted by emcee MCMC
one-dimensional RCF(z) and RCF(M)
RCF vs rPS1 host magnitude, in/out SDSS

episodes.description: Completeness tests of filter, scanning and spectroscopic follow-up

chain.op: re-process 2018 alerts with AMPEL, two filters
cut >=5 detections, peak<18.5, <=1 negative, 5-90 d
GROWTH Marshal filter check
individual vetting of unsaved objects
count 17 missed, 97% completeness
compile saved objects, extra variable/AGN filters
visual examination of 74 unclassified, 31 SN-like
automated rise/fade time estimate
completeness by peak magnitude
